content: Implement W0121's canonical lifecycle extension manifest, generation/epoch state model, versioned exploration bounds, deterministic model checker, and model-check evidence before any lifecycle adapter work.
The exact lifecycle command passed with 949 explored states, 4012 transitions, 326 complete sequences, 13 direct boundary checks, all canonical transitions covered, and no counterexamples.
Lifecycle CTest and its positive/tampered-manifest self-test passed 2/2; the full focused transport and schema suite remains green.
Full dev CTest passed 74/74 after registering the lifecycle model gates; content revision 164a09fc0e528e447ea0f9c63564eb6960357b91 is the W0121 implementation boundary.

Content revision 3c4de28 hardens tools/check-lifecycle-model.py with initialized CUDA/NVML membership, committed-generation membership, provider-loss propagation, repeated CUDA capture, and NVML initialization-epoch assertions. The exact command passed 949 states, 4012 transitions, 326 complete sequences, and 15 direct checks; lifecycle model self-test passed 2/2; lifecycle model CTest selection and full development CTest passed 2/2 and 79/79.

Provider-view coverage remains model-level evidence. Runtime provider publication, fence/telemetry races, lifecycle adapter integration, failure qualification, and ABI freeze remain open under W0121/M0120.

Content revision 860764a adds a versioned fence_telemetry publication branch to the lifecycle model. The deterministic checker passed 337 publication states, 565 transitions, 117 complete sequences, and 6 direct race checks for loss-fence precedence, even telemetry latches, stale ONLINE rejection, and bounded reader retry; the full lifecycle branch remains 949 states and 4012 transitions.

Publication-model self-test passed 5/5, lifecycle CTest selection passed 2/2, and a clean full development CTest passed 79/79. Documentation/content follow-up is recorded in revision 42ded57; the first full run had one daemon compiler-worker isolation flake that passed on focused rerun.

Content revision 941f49f binds legacy and recovery telemetry producers to stable online lifecycle fences and OPEN admission before, during, and after bank staging; marker-complete owner-death recovery validates the target bank before promotion. Legacy and recovery stale/future/loss regressions passed.

Focused runtime registry/recovery CTest passed 2/2; clean full development CTest passed 79/79; clang-format and git diff checks passed. W0121 live provider hooks, transport integration, fault qualification, and lifecycle ABI freeze remain open.
